repair_reason: ANE cache purge handling observed; obsolete archives reclaimed and disk headroom improved from 11 to31GiB. One explicit repair, no automatic retries.
phase_metrics: Per-process medians after two warmups. Decode includes host sampling in both paths; ANE prefill plus KV import separately. Phase sums exclude some frontend/report I/O.
acceptance: Same actual prompt/output IDs and work counts, stable complete sampled stratum, strict zero-compile ANE, all GPU offload logs reviewed for native path. Outer A median decode drift over5percent makes ABBA inconclusive. Two adjacent pairs remain exploratory, not universal performance.
precision_note: ANE uses ordinary Google BF16 checkpoint with INT8 FFNs and FP16 other ANE matrices; native-kit backend uses Google's official native-QAT Q4_0 GGUF with Q6_K embeddings. Different coefficients/precision, not an isolated hardware comparison. No four-bit ANE implementation is involved.
baseline_scope: Native-kit current pinned llama.cpp backend through safe Rust wrappers, not full native-kit frontend request layer.
